papers.summary: The Hippo pathway is evolutionarily conserved to regulate multiple biological processes including development, organ size, apoptosis, and tissue regeneration, thereby maintaining tissue homeostasis. This tumour-suppressive signalling cascade acts inactivates the downstream effectors and oncogenes YAP/TAZ, preventing their binding to the TEAD transcription factors. papers.title: Tumor-derived SERPINB2 and SERPINE1 orchestrate spatially dominant immunosuppressive niches in pancreatic cancer
papers.title_ja: 腫瘍由来SERPINB2およびSERPINE1が膵臓がんの空間的免疫抑制ニッチを統合制御する
papers.summary: PDAC forms a dense, T-cell-excluded tumor microenvironment, but the molecular drivers of this niche remain unclear. Using Perturb-map, a spatial functional genomics platform, we identify the fibrinolysis regulators Serpinb2 (PAI-2) and Serpine1 (PAI-1) as key mediators of immune evasion. Tumor-derived SERPINs stabilize a fibrin-rich ECM that anchors macrophages, promotes immunosuppressive polarization, and excludes cytotoxic T cells. Their deletion suppresses tumor growth and sensitizes PDAC to anti-PD-1 therapy.
papers.summary_ja: Perturb-mapを用いた空間的機能ゲノム解析により、線溶制御因子SERPINB2（PAI-2）とSERPINE1（PAI-1）が膵臓がんの免疫回避を仲介することを同定した。腫瘍微小環境の免疫抑制メカニズムを解明している。
papers.novelty_reason: 空間的機能ゲノム解析によるがん免疫抑制ニッチの機序解明は、腫瘍生物学における新たな実験的視点と治療標的の発見を提供する。
